hits.title: Sanjeev Singh Sahni to Succeed Randy Altschuler as Xometry CEO
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-07-01] Xometry Inc. will hire Sanjeev Singh Sahni as board of directors on Jul 1st '26. Xometry, Inc, North Bethesda, Maryland, USA, has announced that, effective July 1, 2026, Sanjeev Singh Sahni, currently Xometry President, will succeed co-founder Randy Altschuler as Chief Executive Officer and join the company's board of directors.
